body:
I had the chance to talk about Naked Spirituality with Rayborn at Beyond the Box:

 http://www.beyondtheboxpodcast.com/2012/03/brian-mclarennaked-spirituality/

Read the Spirit has a review of my first E-book/short-fiction book, The Word of the Lord to Democrats , here:

 http://www.readthespirit.com/explore/2012/3/16/christian-author-brian-mclaren-leaps-to-fiction-with-a-sting.html

They also have a great N.T. Wright interview where he talks about C. S. Lewis, here:

 http://www.readthespirit.com/explore/2012/3/28/nt-wright-interview-why-left-right-lewis-get-it-wrong.html

Also – my friend Dave Andrews’ books are finally available to American readers … here:

 https://wipfandstock.com/browse/series/The%20Dave%20Andrews%20Legacy%20Series

And for all those who have been thinking about Christian mission around the world, this new book by Jesse Zink is really worth reading:

 https://wipfandstock.com/store/Grace_at_the_Garbage_Dump_Making_Sense_of_Mission_in_the_TwentyFirst_Century
